mapper.select: /* JournalChapterMapper.getDeletedById */ SELECT chapter.id, chapter.created_by, chapter.journal_day_id, chapter.idx, day.yy, day.mnth FROM journal_chapter chapter LEFT JOIN journal_day day ON chapter.journal_day_id = day.id WHERE chapter.id = #{id}
/* JournalChapterMapper.findAllForReorder */ SELECT * FROM journal_chapter WHERE journal_day_id = #{journalDayId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY idx
